Provides Kaplan-Meier survival estimation, a two-group log-rank test, paired sample comparisons and distribution-drift statistics.
Documentation describes local statistical functions and in-process tests; transport interoperability and numerical correctness were not independently tested.
Searches PubMed and retrieves normalized article records or original NCBI XML with explicit missingness and retrieval provenance.
Search logging supports reproducibility but does not establish complete review coverage. Missing abstracts, provider limits and retraction metadata require checking.
Exposes FHIR read, search and operation interfaces backed by a local DuckDB store, with configurable remote-system integration.
Local storage is distinct from a connected clinical backend. Writes are configurable; deployment authorization, backend compatibility and data protection were not verified.
Vitalis MCP — literature and synthetic FHIR
Documents PubMed retrieval and synthetic FHIR patient, condition, medication, observation and encounter workflows.
Retain literature retrieval and synthetic clinical-data operations only. Triage, medication reconciliation, referral and treatment outputs are not independently assessed clinical capabilities.
Retrieves FDA medication-label passages with section headings, manufacturer/version context and links to DailyMed.
Label text is product- and version-specific. Retrieval does not establish comprehensive interaction coverage or patient-specific safety advice.
Demonstrates natural-language epidemiology queries, patient-cohort construction and SQL over a local warehouse with synthetic OMOP and non-OMOP data.
The distributed patients and clinical codes are generated. This is a demonstration, not access to Bayer patient data or evidence of valid epidemiologic estimates; an external model API is required.
Documents read-only retrieval of a patient's own Epic MyChart clinical records through patient-authorized SMART on FHIR access.
Independent personal-use connector. Health-system registration, refresh-token handling, attachment access and production privacy controls were not independently verified.
Packages chronic-disease prediction workflows using public NHIS, BRFSS and NHANES survey data with training, inference and provenance documentation.

Models concern survey-defined outcomes and dataset-specific populations. Reported cross-validation is the author's evidence; survey-design handling, temporal prediction and external clinical validity were not independently checked.
Documents biomedical search and retrieval across PubMed and Europe PMC, with MeSH, citation, full-text and clinical-trial tools.
Only documented literature/trial retrieval is included. Provider coverage, available full text and external-service access can differ; no live results were tested.
Documents NHANES file and variable discovery, analysis-dataset assembly and survey-weighted estimation with cycle-pooling and reliability guidance.

Maintainer-owned product. Weight selection, subsample eligibility, pooled-cycle definitions and statistical outputs need study-specific review; no independent numerical or runtime validation was performed.
Structures quality appraisal of medical-AI studies using APPRAISE-AI domains, multiple model ratings and a human lead reviewer.
Model ratings are not independent human reviewers or proof of instrument validity. Review requires the study's full reporting and qualified adjudication.
Documents observational propensity-score methods, mediation, difference-in-differences, survival analysis, competing risks, imputation and meta-analysis workflows.
Scope is the named clinical-statistics and causal-method components; molecular-only siblings are not included. Packaged calculations and methodological assumptions were not independently validated.
HL7 v2 to FHIR Mapping MCP
Documents field and code mappings from HL7 v2.5.1 to FHIR R4 and conversion of ORM, ADT and ORU messages into transaction bundles with mapping warnings.
Coverage is limited to documented message types and mappings. The author restricts remote deployments to lab or synthetic data; conformance and preservation of clinical meaning were not tested.
Provides documented openEHR/FHIR modelling, validation, synthetic examples, semantic comparison and explicit mapping-proposal workflows.
Independently maintained derivative with an optional private FHIR engine. Public documentation does not establish access to every backend or clinical validity of generated mappings.
Documents openFDA adverse-event case retrieval, ROR/PRR, empirical-Bayes signal scores and stratified exploratory signal screening.

Spontaneous reports do not establish incidence or causality. Empirical-Bayes priors, stratification and derived estimates were not independently checked; source limits and reporting biases remain material.
Guides estimand definition, identification assumptions, power and sensitivity analysis, with documented difference-in-differences and propensity-score examples.
Instructional method support rather than an autonomous validated estimator. Complex timing, dependence, confounding and identification questions require an appropriate study-specific analysis.
Monitors configured topics in PubMed and medRxiv, stores DOI-deduplicated records locally and documents local-model summaries.
Monitoring is not a comprehensive systematic search. Preprints and published articles differ, DOI deduplication can miss records, and generated summaries need verification.
Documents FDA label, FAERS and recall retrieval through structured MCP tools and a LangGraph tool-discovery workflow.
Label-derived interactions and spontaneous reports are not a patient-specific safety assessment. Offline fixtures and author tests do not establish live-source completeness or clinical correctness.
Implements a documented Claude Code workflow for PubMed search, screening and study-characteristics extraction with a static review report.
Author explicitly limits this TrialMind-inspired reimplementation to teaching and method validation. It does not substitute for a completed, independently adjudicated systematic review.
Documents retrieval of PubMed abstracts for diabetes-treatment questions and cited answers using a local or hosted vector index.
Abstract-grounded generated answers may omit full-text eligibility and limitations. Retrieval, citation support and treatment claims were not independently validated.
Retrieves ClinicalTrials.gov protocols, maps eligibility criteria and queries a HAPI FHIR store to generate candidate-patient screening evidence.
Distributed patient data are synthetic. Eligibility mapping, de-identification claims and screening scores were not independently validated; candidate matching is not an enrollment decision.
Documents structured PubMed search, batch abstracts, identifier conversion, related-article retrieval, citation formatting and journal metadata.
A local MCP process still retrieves from external providers. Search completeness, identifier matching and journal metadata were not tested against live sources.
Checks BibTeX, RIS and MEDLINE references against scholarly identifiers and metadata, including PubMed and Crossref, while retaining uncertain matches for review.
Bibliographic agreement does not establish that an article supports a scientific claim. Provider access, ambiguous records and author/title matching need verification.
Documents epidemiology and biostatistics study-design, analysis-plan and reproducible R/Python analysis workflows for Claude Code and Codex.

Only the documented epidemiology, study-design and statistical workflows are included. Writing and presentation components do not independently qualify; instructions cannot establish correct estimands or analysis results.
Documents patient search, observation retrieval and patient resources against a HAPI FHIR R4 server using MCP tools, resources and prompts.
Small interoperability example with an in-memory test suite. Authenticated clinical deployment, complete FHIR resource coverage and live compatibility were not verified.
Documents multi-source scholarly search including PubMed, identifier-based paper retrieval, citation-graph navigation and bibliography formatting.
Hosted retrieval coverage and access may change. A returned identifier does not demonstrate relevance, methodological quality or support for a generated claim.
Documents a configurable clinical-literature surveillance pipeline using PubMed MCP retrieval and ClinicalTrials.gov cross-checks.
Digest generation is scoped to documented retrieval and trial cross-checking. Physician-profile filtering and generated summaries do not establish complete systematic-review coverage.
Documents FHIR R4 EHR access with structured outputs, configurable write restrictions, compact responses and audit-record interfaces.
Security, compliance and determinism are author claims, not registry certifications. Public mock/sandbox descriptions do not establish a deployed hospital integration.
Documents read-only patient, medication, condition, encounter, observation and allergy retrieval with compact FHIR R4 summaries and search normalization.
Author describes synthetic test-server patients only. Summary compression, name/lab matching, audit controls and SMART access were not independently validated.
Searches PubMed or accepts supplied records and uses a typed decision model to return title/abstract screening probabilities and inclusion categories.
Requires the documented model service and credentials. Probabilities and automated screening thresholds are not independently calibrated for the user's review and do not replace adjudication.
Documents a PICO-framed PubMed literature-search and synthesis workflow with DOI/PMID-linked Word output.
Instruction-based synthesis must preserve executed searches and human eligibility decisions. Citations and generated interpretation require checking against the original papers.
Documents generation, validation and explanation of synthetic FHIR resources against StructureDefinition profiles, plus scoped NPHIES claim checks.
Generated examples and schema validation do not establish clinical meaning or payment eligibility. Specific implementation guides and validation engines require separate checks.
Documents retrieval of a full ANZCTR trial registration by ACTRN, including design, eligibility, outcomes, dates and sponsor information.
Current documented scope is identifier lookup; historical search implementation is not included. Unofficial shared-gateway adapter; no live trial call or complete international coverage verified.
Documents EU/EEA CTIS trial search, record details, medicine-specific listings and recent authorizations.
Unofficial adapter to the public CTIS interface. Published fields, paging and authorization dates differ from results evidence; shared gateway tools are outside this component's scope.
Documents ISRCTN registry search and trial-record retrieval for UK and international registered studies.
Unofficial adapter. Registry coverage, source updates, query translation and cross-registry duplicate reconciliation need checking; sibling gateway components are not approved by this record.
Documents cross-registry ICTRP search and trial-registration-data retrieval with source registry and trial identifiers.
Unofficial integration. Aggregate registries can contain duplicate and delayed registrations; availability, anti-bot behavior and record completeness were not tested.
Documents estimand-first review of causal identification, propensity methods, overlap, experiments and Bayesian-model diagnostics.

Retain named statistical-method review components only; advertising optimization, generic production workflows and proof review are outside this inclusion. Model critique is not numerical or methodological validation.
Documents clinical-trial and RWE claim review with evidence retrieval from Europe PMC, ClinicalTrials.gov and openFDA, including date-bounded evidence queries.
Scope is the named health-evidence components. Hosted grading, signed-record verification, performance and privacy claims were not independently tested; other claim classes are not included.
Documents FHIR-based population-health indicator retrieval with units, source references and deterministic integrity checks alongside environmental context.

Retain population-health indicators and their linked integrity checks only. Environmental measurements alone do not establish Core relevance or human-health effects; sandbox quality claims were not independently reproduced.
Documents parameterized queries for CMS HCC risk scores, hospital readmissions, MIPS quality and Part D utilization, with an embedded demonstration mode.
Demo data are distinct from populated production CMS tables. Database setup, freshness, denominators, API access and query correctness were not independently tested.
Documents PubMed/Europe PMC and wider scholarly search, citation chaining, open-access full text, ClinicalTrials.gov lookup and bibliography exports.
Public providers impose distinct coverage and rate limits; offline mock tests do not establish live correctness. Search ranking and deduplication do not guarantee exhaustive evidence capture.
Documents skills for drafting, linting and testing bidirectional openEHR/FHIR mappings, with path-extraction helpers and an engine test harness.
Mapping is beta and draft/testing workflows are alpha; the author reports mock-engine testing for the testing skill. Scope excludes the separate IDE plugin and assumes no clinical mapping validation.
Econometric Data Pipeline Skill — causal methods
Documents panel-data, difference-in-differences, instrumental-variable and double-machine-learning workflows with estimand, merge and provenance checks.
Retain the specific statistical-method workflow rather than generic data engineering. Identification, dependence, estimator implementation and uncertainty require study-specific review.
Open Health Sync — released MCP interface
Documents self-hosted Apple Health and Withings ingestion and read-only MCP access to normalized wearable/health records in release 0.0.2.

FHIR output and additional wearable connectors are described as future-release work and are excluded here. Device measurements, consent, normalization and backend security were not independently verified.
Clinical Trials MCP — REDCap and eligibility SQL
Documents REDCap data-dictionary checks and protocol-derived OMOP eligibility SQL with criterion-to-query traceability and unresolved criteria marked for review.
SQL generation does not connect to a patient database or establish correct eligibility. Generated code, protocol extraction and REDCap compatibility require independent checking.
Documents title/abstract screening ranked by a decision model, with a statistical stopping rule and review-state handling.
Stopping guarantees depend on the sampling and relevance assumptions of the stated method. Model calibration, recall, search coverage and review-specific performance were not independently evaluated.
Documents full-text claim/evidence extraction, structured classification and multi-reviewer voting packets with schema and identity checks.
Model votes are not independent human review. Synthetic fixtures verify packet structure rather than source truth; the described paper-based workflow needs review-specific validation.
Documents biomedical-column profiling and clinical FHIR schema matching using curated mappings, embeddings and optional model-assisted review.
Retain clinical schema matching, not molecular-only analyses. Suggested mappings and calibration do not establish semantic equivalence or production transformation validity.
Documents PubMed/OpenAlex search, citation verification, retraction checking, bibliography formatting and PRISMA count/diagram tools.
A resolvable identifier does not establish claim support or evidence quality. Retraction coverage, ambiguous matches, quotas and hosted-service behavior were not tested.
Zotero Scholar MCP — health literature retrieval
Documents PubMed, Europe PMC and OpenAlex retrieval, merged searches, open-access section retrieval and citation checks with local-library matching.

Scope is the scholar retrieval component; general library administration and editing are excluded. Local Zotero access, write defaults, matching and provider completeness were not independently checked.
Documents shipped ClinicalTrials.gov, FDA labels/events/recalls/approvals and PubMed components with embedded corpora, refresh diagnostics and source-linked retrieval.
Embedded datasets are not complete live upstream inventories. Roadmap sources are excluded; author test counts, cross-source joins, summaries and refresh correctness were not independently verified.
Documents random/stratified sampling, binary and generalized propensity scores, overlap, balance, missingness and covariate-timing review workflows.
Instructional workflow preserves human design decisions but cannot establish exchangeability or timing from column names. Computation and sensitivity analyses require independent statistical review.
Documents medical-library-style PubMed, Europe PMC and trial searches, citation chaining and source-specific search logs with EndNote and methods outputs.
Reported benchmark recall is author evidence and does not transfer automatically to a new review. Provider coverage, translation and licensing constraints need checking.
Documents structured outbreak-source retrieval, incident extraction and status-labeled tracking with multilingual search sweeps and a page validator.

Compiled public reporting is not official surveillance statistics or validated outbreak detection. Source verification and incident definitions require public-health review; scheduled delivery is a workflow instruction, not a built-in data feed.
Documents PubMed-first structured searches, preprint and trial-register expansion, citation chasing, full-text verification and review audit steps.
Instructions describe an evidence-review process but do not establish complete retrieval or independent human screening. Reported reliability and model audit independence were not validated.
Documents multi-source scholarly retrieval including PubMed, identifier deduplication, sorting and structured exports.
Retain biomedical retrieval only. Subscription databases, screenshot/OCR fallback, journal rankings and provider credentials have separate coverage and rights constraints; no live retrieval tested.
Documents literature search/screen/extract workflows and an oncology trial/FDA extraction scaffold with provenance templates and consistency validation.

Packaged examples are fictional and the validator checks consistency rather than source truth. The scaffold is not a collected cohort or a completed meta-analysis; human extraction and adjudication remain required.
Documents a local Python disease-spread modelling module with a data loader and an interface for agent invocation.
Documentation and author test claims do not establish epidemiologic adequacy. Model equations, calibration, population assumptions and predictive validity were not independently reviewed.
Documents reference checks for LaTeX, BibTeX and PDF inputs against scholarly metadata including PubMed, with read-only MCP access.
Bibliographic matching does not establish that a paper supports a claim. Parsing, ambiguous records and provider coverage were not independently tested.
Documents retrieval of CDISC standards metadata, controlled-terminology packages, codelists and Biomedical Concepts through the CDISC Library API.
Requires a CDISC Library account/API key. Metadata retrieval does not validate a submission dataset or establish correct mapping to a study-specific CDISC standard.
Recall Radar — medicine and device component
Documents FDA medicine and medical-device recall retrieval and EMA medicine-shortage lookup with source URLs and dates.
Scope excludes general household/product recall tools. The smart-display front end is simulated and has not been connected to Alexa; source freshness and live MCP outputs were not tested.
Documents read-only discovery and retrieval of versioned healthcare quality-measure packages, including CQL/SQL/SQL-on-FHIR artifacts and implementation questions.
A measure corpus is distinct from a validated measure engine. Included artifacts, interpretation notes and test cases require version-specific review; execution against clinical data was not tested.
